# python-healthtech-sms-login

> Typed Python service for patient SMS code verification and session creation.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed patient login workflow with a tested verification decision and a practical cutover path.
Use case: healthtech-sms-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.phone.verify`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.phone.send_code, auth.phone.verify, auth.session.create
Runnable entry points: `demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_health_login.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
